sota_to_phase_d_mapping.implementation_delta: Over Exp 5031-5036, replace the scalar D1 LoRA scorer and D3 EBRM readout with an EORM-style small energy head over frozen MuSR candidates, then rerun delta_vs_tuned_sc and second-corpus confirmation.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.method: EORM small energy outcome reward verifier
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.pitfall: Outcome-only labels can learn answer-shape shortcuts; the rerun needs frozen candidates, no model-id features, and the same genuine tuned-SC baseline.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.source_signal: Uses an energy-based outcome reward model to rank chain-of-thought solutions with only outcome labels, reporting a 55M-parameter verifier that can select from candidate pools and generalize to unseen models.

sota_to_phase_d_mapping.implementation_delta: Over Exp 5031-5036, build a D2 process-reward replay that uses only oracle-distinct intermediate checks available before the final answer, then expose the same confidence as the cheap D6 router before judge calls.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.pitfall: The method is only non-circular if the intermediate verifier is not the answer oracle; weak or domain-leaking checks would invalidate the moat claim.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.source_signal: Converts symbolic or algorithmic intermediate checks into dense turn-level rewards for agentic reasoning, improving credit assignment when reliable local verification is available.

sota_to_phase_d_mapping.implementation_delta: Over Exp 5031-5036, compute rollout-success process scores for cached candidate prefixes and distill them into the D2 selector or D3 energy margin before comparing against tuned self-consistency.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.pitfall: Continuation rollouts can be expensive and can leak final-answer verification into the selector; the rerun must charge compute and keep the verifier oracle-distinct.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.source_signal: Assigns step rewards by sampling continuations from intermediate reasoning states and using empirical final-verification success, avoiding an explicit trained PRM.

sota_to_phase_d_mapping.implementation_delta: Over Exp 5031-5036, turn D1/D3 scalar verifier scores into reward distributions, penalize high-overlap uncertain candidates, and route only uncertain pairs to D6 judge fallback.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.pitfall: PURM is preference-alignment evidence, not a direct reasoning-selector result; calibration gains must not be counted unless selection accuracy improves.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.source_signal: Generalizes Bradley-Terry reward modeling to reward distributions and uses distribution overlap as per-sample uncertainty to reduce reward hacking.

sota_to_phase_d_mapping.implementation_delta: Over Exp 5031-5036, add a cheap consequence-evaluation branch to D6: candidate traces become exemplars for generated neighboring checks, and only low-margin cases escalate to the judge.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.pitfall: Generating related verifiable questions can become the expensive verifier; the cascade must charge that cost and prevent neighborhood tasks from leaking answers.
sota_to_phase_d_mapping.source_signal: Scores a candidate solution by testing whether it improves solving of related verifiable questions, outperforming reward models, generative reward models, and LLM judges on research-level math ranking.
